lead: Sadashiv Amrapurkar was an Indian stage actor, born on 11 May 1950 in Ahilyanagar.
He died on 3 November 2014 in Mumbai at the age of 64.
He has 42 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor and Filmfare Award for Best Performance in a Negative Role.
The sections that follow break down Sadashiv Amrapurkar's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
